title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 17.6 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions from 17.6 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 could allow an authenticated user to read Kubernetes Secrets from other namespaces in clusters connected via the GitLab agent for Kubernetes. This occurs due to incorrect authorization in workspaces. The issue has been remediated in the specified fixed versions.
